rule: sensitivity numbers computed from existing machinery or cited from results/*.json acceptance records; no new fits

assumptions.name: kappa_hw
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: slack_stiffness = κ_t/κ_hw linear in 1/κ_hw; κ(diffusion N=1024)=1.049e+06 @ κ_hw=1e+06 → flips verdict at Δκ_hw = −4.86%
assumptions.falsification_observation: measure κ_hw on silicon (τ_min parasitic, τ_max leakage/1f): §9 risk 1 — real window may be 1e4, halving the feasible PDE set; a workload flips at −4.86%

assumptions.name: alpha_B_hw
assumptions.display: α 时间缩放 / B_hw 频窗位置
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: scaled bandwidth axis sits at margin=0.8 of the window (raw 0.08 → post-scaling 0.8·B_hw/B_hw); a 20% B_hw reduction flips the verdict
assumptions.falsification_observation: §6.15 PhysicalScaling verdict flip: comparing raw model bandwidth to B_hw without α is the error; 20% B_hw shrink flips every α-scaled workload

assumptions.name: noise_psd
assumptions.display: 噪声 PSD / B_noise 带宽
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: variance deficit d/dr[1−(2/π)arctan r] = 0.006303 per unit B_noise/B_req at r=10 (measured 669.33% deficit at r=10, predicted 634.51%)
assumptions.falsification_observation: §9 risk 8: B_noise insufficient ⇒ OU variance systematically low ≥6% at B_noise/B_req=10 — a bias, not noise; PSD convention (two-sided) mix-up is a 3 dB error (§1.3)

assumptions.name: mismatch
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: mismatch floor linear in ε_dev: floor(2%)/floor(1%)=2.000, floor=0.0522 per 1% ε_dev; amplified 1/λ_min (N=128/32 floor ratio 8.61, results/constraint.json)
assumptions.falsification_observation: P0-D contract: Γ_proj‖ΔA‖ is only valid for conservative ΔA; leakage mismatch must be budgeted by drift (∝1/λ_min), else the robustness axis silently under-reports

assumptions.name: parasitics
assumptions.display: 寄生 / 路由相位预算
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: route phase error 2.86°/buffer level (depth1 2.86°, depth4 11.45° vs 3° budget → 1-level margin); η_route per level 4.99%
assumptions.source: results/route.json buffers (2.86°/level) + crosstalk floor 9.09% (1 mV/V C_m budget)
assumptions.falsification_observation: per-edge passes but the loop fails (§6.15: deskew 3e-7 ps yet 2.15° absolute delay violates a 1° reserve) — per-edge contracts are necessary, not sufficient

assumptions.name: calibration_residual
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: isometry after right-Gram 2.90e-15; at 2% calibration residual 0.342 (§6.16 measured) → d(isometry)/d(residual)≈17/unit; left-multiply trap: naive isometry 0.032
assumptions.falsification_observation: §9 risk 2: θ(t) drifts with temperature ⇒ ΔA time-varying, H2/H∞ need periodic recompute; wrong left-Gram multiplication leaves isometry at 0.032 silently

assumptions.name: excess_noise_gamma
assumptions.display: 过剩噪声因子 γ_eff / α
assumptions.sensitivity_definition: σ_y² = α·kT/C linear in α, σ_y ∝ √α → d log σ_y/d log α = 1/2 (exact, formula-derived §1.2(B)); §9 risk 3: real γ_eff 5–10× nominal ⇒ SNR budget optimistic by 7–10 dB
assumptions.falsification_observation: real OTA γ_eff and excess noise 5–10× nominal ⇒ every σ_y in the certificates is optimistic by 7–10 dB; re-measure per-primitive (§C1), never reuse nominal
